message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on the NetZero pallet. Pallets are classified in heading 4415, "Packing cases, boxes, crates, drums and similar packings, of wood; cable-drums of wood; pallets, box pallets and other load boards, of wood". Subheading 4415.20 covers pallets, box pallets and other load boards, and its statistical suffixes are:

- 4415.20.4000: Pallets
- 4415.20.8000: Other

Particle board is wood, so heading 4415 applies. The pallet is made of molded wood particle composite, and Note 1 to Chapter 44 excludes some goods, but nothing there applies here. The ruling I recall classified it in 4415.20.80 as "other", though the 2012 HTS has 4415.20.40 for "Pallets and box pallets" and 4415.20.80 for "Other". I think the ruling put it under 4415.20.4000, but I'm not certain. Pallets fall under 4415.20.40, and the current structure reads 4415.20.40 "Pallets", 4415.20.80 "Other", with subdivisions 4415.20.4010 and 4415.20.4090 in some versions. In the current HTS, 4415.20.40 has a 00 statistical suffix, so I'll go with 4415.20.4000.

{"hts_code": "4415.20.4000", "reason": "The molded wood-particle composite shipping pallet is a pallet of wood (particle board) classified in heading 4415, subheading 4415.20 for pallets, box pallets and other load boards."}
